'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**Two people are killed and three others are injured in a "record [[military drone|drone]] attack" on [[Kyiv]]. [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] authorities say they have shot down 52 of 54 drones. [https://www.euronews.com/2023/05/27/ukraine-war-kyiv-requests-german-missiles-as-counter-offensive-looms (Euronews)]
*[[Kivu conflict]]
**Two [[park ranger|rangers]] are killed in a shooting at [[Virunga National Park]] in [[North Kivu]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/gunmen-kill-two-rangers-congos-virunga-national-park-2023-05-28/ (Reuters)]
*[[2023 Manipur violence]]
**Thirty-three tribal [[militant]]s are killed by [[Indian Army|soldiers]] during an operation in [[Manipur]], [[India]], following ethnic clashes in the region. [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/around-33-tribal-militants-killed-clashes-indias-manipur-minister-2023-05-28/ (Reuters)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Prime Minister of India|Indian Prime Minister]] [[Narendra Modi]] [[inaugurate]]s a [[New Parliament House, New Delhi|new parliament building]] capable of holding 1,272 MPs. The ceremony is boycotted by the opposition for not asking [[President of India|President]] [[Droupadi Murmu]] to inaugurate it and for selecting the birthday of [[Hindutva]] founder [[Vinayak Damodar Savarkar]] as the inauguration date, while [[Delhi Police]] detain wrestlers [[Bajrang Punia]] and [[Sakshi Malik]] for protesting the [[sexual abuse]] of female athletes at the ceremony. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-65718127 (BBC News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*The [[Comac C919]], China's first domestically-built [[passenger jet]], completes its first [[commercial flight]] from [[Shanghai]] to [[Beijing]] by [[China Eastern Airlines]]. [https://apnews.com/article/china-comac-c919-first-commercial-flight-6c2208ac5f1ed13e18a5b311f4d8e1ad (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Three people are injured in [[Battagram District]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]], when a magnitude 5.2 [[earthquake]] strikes [[Badakhshan Province|Badakshan]], [[Afghanistan]]. [https://www.dawn.com/news/1756386 (Dawn)]
*[[Lake Maggiore boat incident]]
**Four people are killed and five others injured when a boat [[capsize]]s amid bad weather on [[Lake Maggiore]] in [[Lombardy]], [[Italy]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-65741465 (BBC News)]
*Buildings and roads are damaged across [[Melbourne]] by a magnitude 4.0 [[list of earthquakes in Australia|earthquake]] in [[Victoria (state)|Victoria]], [[Australia]]. [https://www.afr.com/politics/federal/damage-reports-as-melbourne-hit-by-magnitude-3-8-earthquake-20230528-p5dby4 (AFR)]
*[[Davenport Hotel (Davenport, Iowa)|An apartment building]] partially collapses in [[Davenport, Iowa]], [[United States]], killing three people. [https://apnews.com/article/iowa-davenport-building-collapse-c0052453e96a267b53bfd975b16985c9 (Associated Press)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Turkish presidential election]]
**Citizens in [[Turkey]] head to [[polling place|the polls]] to vote in the second round of the [[President of Turkey|presidential]] election. [https://apnews.com/article/turkey-presidential-election-erdogan-kilicdaroglu-d4f8adee43d7cc807b39d1f47ef4baea (AP)]
**[[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]] is declared the winner by the [[Supreme Election Council (Turkey)|Supreme Election Council]], defeating his opponent [[Kemal Kılıçdaroğlu]] with 52 percent of the vote. [https://www.tagesschau.de/ausland/asien/tuerkei-wahl-ergebnis-100.html (''Tagesschau'')]
*[[Politics of Spain]]
**[[2023 Spanish local elections|Local]] and [[2023 Spanish regional elections|regional elections]] are held in [[Spain]]. [https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-municipales/ (''El País'')]
*[[Politics of Somalia]]
**[[Somalia]] announces that beginning next year, the country will change to a [[presidential system]] and elect officials by [[direct vote]], ending more than three decades of [[indirect voting]] where lawmakers elected the country's leaders with the approval of clan and elderly leaders. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/somalia-says-it-will-revert-direct-vote-officials-starting-next-year-2023-05-28/ (Reuters)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2023 Indianapolis 500]]
**Two-time series champion [[Josef Newgarden]] wins the 107th [[Indianapolis 500]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/05/28/sport/josef-newgarden-indy-500-winner/index.html (CNN)]
